query: INSERT INTO push_devices (org_id, user_id, employee_id, app, token, locale, platform, device_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (token) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET org_id = EXCLUDED.org_id, user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, employee_id = EXCLUDED.employee_id, app = EXCLUDED.app, locale = EXCLUDED.locale, platform = EXCLUDED.platform, device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id, last_seen_at = now()
